name: shortcut-recorder
title: ShortcutRecorder
description: Source-owned shortcut recorder control backed by TanStack Hotkeys recorder state and ShortcutDisplay.

meta.api: ShortcutRecorder is a button-like control with value, onValueChange, onCancel, onClear, recorderOptions, placeholder, recordingLabel, and ShortcutDisplay formatOptions props.
meta.behavior: Clicking starts TanStack Hotkeys createHotkeyRecorder. Recording writes the captured hotkey through onValueChange, Escape cancels, and Backspace/Delete clears through onValueChange(undefined).
meta.accessibility: ShortcutRecorder renders a native button, defaults type=button, sets aria-pressed while recording, and preserves caller labels through children. Applications should place it in a labelled settings row when editing user preferences.
meta.dataAttributes: Stable hooks use data-scope="ui-shortcut-recorder" and data-part values for trigger, label, value, and placeholder. Trigger exposes data-recording and data-empty.
meta.ssr: Rendering does not read browser globals. Recording starts only from user interaction after hydration through TanStack Hotkeys recorder source.
meta.limitations: This records one chord. Multi-step Vim-style sequences belong to ShortcutSequenceRecorder. Persistence, conflict resolution, and user preference storage stay in app-owned source.

parity.tanstackHotkeys: Wraps createHotkeyRecorder and preserves recorderOptions while adding generated UI markup and data attributes.
parity.shadcn: Source-owned settings-control ergonomics: a native button with compact kbd display, easy to restyle or replace after install.
parity.keystoneCore: Does not add Core primitive behavior. It is an app settings control for user shortcut preferences.
